description: Linux-only app-local IANA time zone data (tzdata 2026f) for .NET. Ships compiled TZif files and sets TZDIR via an explicit TzDataRuntime.Configure() call, so TimeZoneInfo works on Alpine, Chiseled and Distroless images without system tzdata. macOS is not supported; Windows is a no-op (NLS/registry).
